name: Drain Cleaning
description: Professional drain cleaning services to clear clogs and restore proper flow in your plumbing system
problems: Recurring clogs in kitchen or bathroom drains
Water backing up in multiple fixtures
solutions: Hydro jetting for thorough pipe cleaning
Video camera inspection to identify blockages
Enzymatic drain treatments for organic buildup

faqs.question: How often should I have my drains professionally cleaned?
faqs.answer: We recommend professional drain cleaning every 18-24 months for preventive maintenance, or immediately if you notice slow drainage or recurring clogs.

faqs.question: Is hydro jetting safe for old pipes?
faqs.answer: Yes, when performed by trained professionals. We inspect pipes with a camera first to ensure they can handle the pressure, and adjust our equipment accordingly.

faqs.question: What causes most drain clogs?
faqs.answer: Common culprits include hair, soap scum, food debris, grease buildup, and foreign objects. Tree roots can also infiltrate outdoor drain lines.
